# Mario's Super Soil

> Mario's Super Soil is a Canadian company in Mississauga, Ontario that makes organic dry soil amendments (meals, rock dusts, worm castings, compost and blends) for gardeners and growers. Orders ship across Canada. Wholesale is available to garden centres and stores.

Key facts:
- Location: Mississauga, ON, Canada. Phone 647-839-7645. Email mariossupersoil@mariossupersoil.com.
- Products are organic dry amendments in 2 lb and 5 lb bags with directions in English and French; larger orders are packed as multiple 5 lb bags.
- Ships within Canada only. Orders of $120 or more include a free 2 lb bag of Level Up 3-3-3 or Flower Power 2-6-4. 30 day returns on unused items.
- Main blends: Level Up 3-3-3 and Flower Power 2-6-4. A Super Starter Pack is available in 2 lb and 5 lb sizes.

- [Bone, crab, feather, kelp and alfalfa meal compared](https://mariossupersoil.ca/guides/bone-crab-feather-meal/): How the five meal amendments differ and when to use each one.
- [Organic amendments for Ontario vegetable gardens](https://mariossupersoil.ca/guides/vegetable-garden-ontario/): A simple spring-to-summer plan for feeding an organic vegetable bed.
- [Worm castings vs compost](https://mariossupersoil.ca/guides/worm-castings-vs-compost/): What each one does, how to use them, and why many gardeners use both.
- [Dolomite lime, oyster shell and gypsum compared](https://mariossupersoil.ca/guides/dolomite-lime-oyster-shell-gypsum/): Three calcium sources compared: which one raises pH and which one does not.
- [Organic amendments for pots and containers](https://mariossupersoil.ca/guides/potted-plants-containers/): Per-gallon doses for feeding potted plants and container gardens.
- [Soil amendment calculator](https://mariossupersoil.ca/soil-calculator/): free tool that works out amounts by plant, bed or pot size.
- [Plant Dr. Mario](https://mariossupersoil.ca/plant-drmario/): upload a plant photo for amendment suggestions.

## Product details

### Flower Power 2-6-4
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/flower-power/
NPK: 2 - 6 - 4
Best for: For blooms and bigger yields
Flower Power 2-6-4 is a premium organic dry amendment that promotes strong roots, lush growth, and vibrant blooms in indoor and outdoor flowering plants. Its nutrient-rich formula supports abundant flower production, with easy application and clear instructions for gardeners of all experience levels. Made from alfalfa meal, bone meal, soft rock phosphate, KMS, glacial rock dust, kelp meal, oyster shell flour, gypsum and azomite.
How to use: Use 1 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For mature plants, use 2 tbsp per gallon. Use 1/2 tbsp for seedlings.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Crab Meal 4-3-0
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/crab-meal/
NPK: 4 - 3 - 0
Best for: Root and pest protection, plus calcium
Crab meal is an organic dry amendment made from crab & lobster shells, providing nutrients that support healthy soil & flower and vegetable growth. The NPK ratio of crab meal is 4-3-0, with a high concentration of nitrogen, phosphorus, and magnesium, and it is particularly rich in chitin.
How to use: Apply in spring and every 2–3 months. Use 1–2 teaspoons per gallon of soil. Yellow leaves may indicate nitrogen deficiency.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Bone Meal 4-10-0
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/bone-meal/
NPK: 4 - 10 - 0
Best for: Phosphorus for roots, blooms and fruit
Bone meal is an organic dry amendment made from ground animal bones, rich in phosphorus to support strong roots & healthy plant growth. It also provides calcium, iron, magnesium, and zinc, helping promote healthy stems, leaves, flowers, seeds and fruit production.
How to use: Apply 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil. Mix in and water lightly. Nutrients release over 4 months.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Kelp Meal 1-0-4
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/kelp-meal/
NPK: 1 - 0 - 4
Best for: Ocean minerals for stress and root growth
Kelp is a marine algae sourced from nutrient-rich oceans. Often combined with fish products, it promotes healthier plant growth, improves yields, & enhances garden quality. With an NPK ratio of 1-0-4, kelp meal releases nutrients quickly and provides over 70 vitamins and minerals, including essential micronutrients and macronutrients.
How to use: Mix 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Apply monthly during the growing season.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Alfalfa Meal 3-0.5-3
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/alfalfa-meal/
NPK: 3 - 0.5 - 3
Best for: Gentle nitrogen and a growth boost
Enhance your garden with Alfalfa Meal, an organic dry amendment and soil conditioner rich in nutrients that promote healthy plant growth. Made from fermented alfalfa seeds, it has a light texture and pleasant earthy aroma. Apply generously around flowering perennials and shrubs.
How to use: Mix 2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Apply around plants and hedges, mix into soil, and water. Apply in spring; repeat every 6 weeks for long-blooming plants.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Feather Meal 11-0-0
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/feather-meal/
NPK: 11 - 0 - 0
Best for: Slow nitrogen for lush leaves
Feather meal is an organic dry amendment made from poultry feathers, processed under high heat and pressure, then finely ground into a nutrient-rich powder. With an NPK ratio of 11-0-0, it provides essential nitrogen for plant development, particularly during the vegetative stage, through both immediate and slow-release nutrition.
How to use: Apply 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil or coco. Mix in and water thoroughly. Avoid overapplication.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Soft Rock Phosphate 0-3-0
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/soft-rock-phosphate/
NPK: 0 - 3 - 0
Best for: Slow phosphorus and calcium
Soft rock phosphate is a natural mineral amendment derived from fossilized marine organisms formed millions of years ago. It provides slow-release phosphorus, silicon, boron, and trace minerals, improving soil fertility and retaining calcium around plant roots for healthier growth.
How to use: Apply 1 cup per plant at planting or early in the season. For gardens, use 10 lbs per 100 square feet monthly. For containers, mix 2 tbsp per gallon of soil.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Gypsum
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/gypsum/
NPK: Soil amendment
Best for: Loosens clay, adds calcium and sulfur
Gypsum is a natural mineral rich in calcium and sulfur, helping improve water absorption, reduce soil erosion, and support plant growth. It has little effect on soil pH but helps roots grow by reducing aluminum toxicity, especially in acidic soils, promoting healthier development.
How to use: Use 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For foliar spray, mix 1/2–1 tsp per gallon of water and spray leaves evenly. For soil drench, mix 1–2 tbsp per gallon of water.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Oyster Shell Flour
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/oyster-shell-flour/
NPK: Soil amendment
Best for: Slow calcium and a steady pH
Oyster shell flour contains 96% calcium carbonate and micronutrients, providing slow-release nutrition while helping maintain balanced soil pH levels. Its gradual breakdown provides lasting calcium, reducing the risk of nutrient lockout and supporting consistent nutrient availability for healthier plant growth.
How to use: New pots: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Established plants: 1 tbsp per gallon. Base mixes: 1 cup per 30 L. Garden beds: 2.5–5 lbs per 100 square feet, mixed into the top 3 inches of soil.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Dolomite Lime
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/dolomite-lime/
NPK: Soil amendment
Best for: Raises pH, adds calcium and magnesium
Dolomite lime is a natural mineral amendment containing calcium and magnesium, essential nutrients that support healthy soil and plant growth. Rich in calcium and magnesium carbonates, it helps balance soil pH, reduce acidity, and improve nutrient availability for healthier plants and gardens.
How to use: Use 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. To raise soil pH from 5.5 to 6.5, use approximately 5 lbs per 100 square feet.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Basalt Rock Dust
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/basalt-rock-dust/
NPK: Soil amendment
Best for: Trace minerals and silica for strong stems
Basalt rock dust is a natural soil amendment made from finely ground volcanic rock, commonly found around the world. It breaks down easily in soil, releasing essential minerals that help replenish nutrients, improve soil health, and support stronger plant growth.
How to use: Use 1 tbsp (15 ml) per gallon (4 L) for potting, transplanting, or monthly feeding. For living soil, use 1/4 - 3/8 cup (4–6 tbsp) per gallon.
Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags

### Worm Castings 1.5-2.5-1.3
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/worm-castings/
NPK: 1.5 - 2.5 - 1.3
Best for: Live biology for any soil
Worm castings are a natural soil amendment produced by earthworms, also known as vermicast. These castings consist of earthworm waste. As worms consume compost materials, their nutrient-rich waste creates a superior soil amendment that supports healthier plant growth.
How to use: Mix into potting soil or sprinkle around plants. For established plants, use 1–2 cups. Water thoroughly.
Sizes: 1 L; 1 gallon; 2 gallons; 4 gallons

### Compost Blend 0.7-0.3-0.6
URL: https://mariossupersoil.ca/products/compost-blend/
NPK: 0.7 - 0.3 - 0.6
Best for: Organic matter that builds humus
Compost is a carefully balanced mixture of organic materials utilized as a plant amendment, improving the physical, chemical, and biological properties of soil. It is typically produced by decomposing plant matter, food waste recycling of organic materials, and various types of manure.
How to use: Mix 1 part compost with 4 parts soil, or spread on garden beds and lawns. For compost tea, aerate in water for 24–48 hours.
Sizes: 1 L; 1 gallon; 2 gallons; 4 gallons


## FAQ

Q: What makes your products different?
A: Low usage rates: Level Up 3-3-3 and Flower Power 2-6-4 use 1 tablespoon per gallon of soil, so a bag goes a long way. The bags are recyclable and reusable, and everything is made locally in Mississauga, Ontario.

Q: Are your products organic?
A: Yes. All products are made from organic ingredients to improve soil health and plant growth, with no synthetic chemicals.

Q: Can beginners use them?
A: Yes. Every bag has clear usage instructions, and the Super Starter Pack is built for new gardeners.

Q: Do they work indoors and outdoors?
A: Yes. They work for indoor and outdoor gardens, year-round.

Q: Can I use them in hydroponic systems?
A: They work in soil-based systems and coco coir setups that include nutrient amendments. They are not suitable for traditional liquid-only hydroponic systems.

Q: Do they change soil pH?
A: Some do. Dolomite lime helps balance pH, while gypsum makes nutrients more available without significantly changing it.

Q: How much of the other amendments should I use?
A: Gypsum: 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil or coco. Dolomite lime: 5 lb per 100 sq ft to raise pH by one point. Oyster shell flour: 2.5–5 lb per 100 sq ft, mixed into the top 3 inches of soil.

Q: Can I plant in the empty bag?
A: Yes. The bags are reusable, so you can fill them with soil and plant directly in them.

Q: How long does shipping take?
A: Most orders arrive in 2 to 3 business days. Please allow 2 to 10 business days, depending on the carrier, the weather and where you live. Shipping is a flat rate based on the weight of your order.

Q: Do you ship to the USA?
A: Not at this time. We currently ship within Canada only.

Q: What is your return policy?
A: You have 30 days from receiving an item to request a return. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, with proof of purchase. Email us before sending anything back, because returns without prior authorization are not accepted. Return shipping is paid by the customer. Perishable goods, clearance items and hazardous materials cannot be returned. If an item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us right away.
